Champat Rai to Continue Ayodhya Sाधन with 4-Month Ritual Amid Controversy Over Temple Funds

Champat Rai, the former secretary of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, has begun a four-month ritual in Ayodhya amid controversy over temple funds. The ritual started on Devshayanee Ekadashi and will continue until Devotthan Ekadashi. Rai will perform Ram mantra japa and recite Ramcharitmanas for six hours daily during his one-month-long solitary confinement.
